visualCharacteristics.purpose: Rotating text-only callouts: heading, paragraph and a CTA per slide
visualCharacteristics.description: Solid dark wellness-blue band with padding. Rotating text-only callouts (2 slides): white H3, paragraph, white button (Learn more about us / Take a quiz). Arrow/pause/dot controls centered below.

contentPattern.structure: 1 or 2 columns, one row per slide: content cell = heading, paragraph, CTA link (an optional image cell is supported)

usage: Place in a section styled `dark-blue`. Autoplays with prev/pause/next and dot controls below.
reuseGuidance: Use for rotating text-only messages. Use `carousel-promo` when slides carry an image.
